units.source_text: 后来命妇又含泪禀告道：“夜已很深了。

en.t: Later, the myobu again reported through her tears, "The night is already very late.

units.source_text: 今夜之内必须回宫复奏。”

en.t: I must return to the palace and make my report before this night is over."
She then hurriedly prepared to set out.

units.source_text: 其时凉月西沉，夜天如水；

en.t: At that time, the cool moon was sinking in the west, and the night sky was clear as water;
a cold wind brushed her face, and she suddenly felt a deep desolation;
the insects in the grass cried out in confusion, urging one to shed tears.

units.source_text: 命妇对此情景，留恋不忍遽去，遂吟诗道：

en.t: Moved by this scene, the myobu lingered and could not bear to leave at once, so she recited a poem:
